manifest.name: dsh-awesome-agent-preset
manifest.description: Ultra-lean daily coding agent preset for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): direct tools over orchestration, fast and responsive.
manifest.author: Jaylor-Wang

bundle.text:
# ── Shell 运行时与沙箱执行器环境配置 ──────────────────────────────────────────────
- id: bash-sandbox
  disabled: false
  # 部署基线：默认前台命令超时 120000ms，最大 600000ms，宽限缓冲 3000ms（单流输出上限由全局或官方默认 64KB 维护）
  config:
    timeoutMs: 120000
    maxTimeoutMs: 600000
    graceMs: 3000

- id: tool-pwsh
  disabled: true

- id: pwsh-sandbox
  disabled: true

# ── Agent 预设主体 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Agent preset awesome-agent
# Ultra-lean daily coding agent: files, shell, skills, background jobs;
# no present/goals/plan mode/subagents/todo/web tools.
# Composition is frozen at mount — edit this file, reinstall, start a new session.
- insert:
    - id: preset-awesome-agent
      name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset"
      config:
        id: awesome-agent
        name: awesome-agent
        order: 10
        description: 极简瘦身版日常编码 Agent：保留文件、Shell、Skills、后台任务；不含 文件交付工具(present) / 目标 / 计划 / 子代理 / TODO。
        plugins:
          - id: persona
            name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona"
            config:
              prefix: >-
                You are a master autonomous software engineer powered by the {{model}} model.
                Bias toward direct action over speculation: investigate via concurrent tools (fs, bash, skills) without orchestration overhead (no workflows, ralph, or delegation).
                Avoid pre-action narration. Deliver surgical edits and high-signal conclusions.
                Irreversible operations (npm publish): STRICTLY conservative and non-autonomous. NEVER bump versions or mutate artifacts to bypass failures; registry validation causes transient 404 or stale views—NEVER treat as failure or retry publish. MUST verify remote state with read-only commands before declaring status.

          - id: agent-instructions
            name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions"
            config:
              maxBytes: 65536

          # ── shell ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
          - id: tool-bash
            name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash"
            config:
              enableRunInBackground: true
              promoteOnTimeout: true

          # ── filesystem ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
          - id: tool-fs
            name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs"
            config:
              read: true
              readImage: true
              write: true
              edit: true
              readLimit: 800
              readMaxLineLength: 600
              readMaxBytes: 120000

          - id: tool-fs-search
            name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search"
            config:
              sampleOverCapGlobResults: false
              globMaxResults: 50
              grepMaxMatches: 50
              grepMaxLineBytes: 500

          # ── background jobs ───────────────────────────────────────────────
          - id: tool-jobs
            name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs"

          # ── skills ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
          - id: skill-filesystem
            name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem"

          - id: tool-skill
            name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill"

          # ── compaction ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
          - id: compaction
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true
            config:
              - id: compaction-basic
                name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic"
                config:
                  auto: false
                  thresholdRatio: 0.8
                  retainRatio: 0.03

              - id: command-compact
                name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact"

          # ── interaction ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
          - id: tool-ask-user
            name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ask-user"
          # No tool-web: web_search/web_fetch stay off this body; the host `web`
          # service remains. Research and URL reads belong in skills.

Ultra-lean daily coding agent preset for [DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

- **Lean & Responsive**: Removes heavy orchestration layers (no file delivery tool (`present`), goals, complex plan modes, sub-agents, or TODO trackers). Focuses purely on fast, direct coding cycles.
- **Essential Tooling**: Retains core tools needed for day-to-day software development:
  - File reading, editing, and fast directory scanning (`fs`, `fs-search`)
  - Full-featured Bash execution (`tool-bash`)
  - Background asynchronous task management (`tool-jobs`)
  - External skill packs support (`skill-filesystem`, `tool-skill`)
  - On-demand context compaction & memory protection (`compaction`, `/compact`)
- **Tuned FS & Search Efficiency (Aligned with AGENTS.md)**:
  - `tool-fs-search`: caps `glob` results to ≤ 50 entries and `grep` matches to ≤ 50 (preview ≤ 500 bytes/line), preventing context flooding and utilizing spill files when exceeded.
  - `tool-fs`: `readLimit: 800` (max 600 chars/line, max 120KB), ensuring cohesive code units are read in full while preventing massive monolithic files from blowing up token windows.
- **Resilient Bash & Long-running Job Execution**:
  - `tool-bash`: enables background job support and `promoteOnTimeout: true` (smoothly promotes timed-out

Run in your DeepSeek Harness environment:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-awesome-agent-preset

dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Jaylor-Wang/dsh-awesome-agent-preset
```

Or clone locally and link into your DSH profile:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Jaylor-Wang/dsh-awesome-agent-preset.git
```

1. Restart or launch DeepSeek Harness (`dsh web`).
2. In the preset dropdown list above the prompt input bar, select **`awesome-agent`**.
3. Start coding!
